cohort: The study included 372 high-risk pregnant women (e.g., preeclampsia, IUGR, oligohydramnios, postdated pregnancy) who underwent modified biophysical profile evaluations from 37 weeks gestation onwards.
finding: The study found that the need for LSCS, intrapartum fetal distress, meconium-stained liquor, lower APGAR scores, need for neonatal resuscitation, and overall perinatal morbidity were higher in cases with an abnormal Modified Biophysical Profile.
mod_finding: The need for Lower Segment Caesarean Section (LSCS) was found to be higher in cases with abnormal Modified Biophysical Profile.
gest_age: Surveillance performed from 37 weeks of gestation onwards
